title: Fit the gearbox output lip seal square and flush without cutting its lip
instruction: Fit the new seal in the gearbox housing, lip facing in and flush with the face, without damaging it, then put the tools back.
context: Industrial machinery mechanics, machinery maintenance workers and millwrights (about 547,300 US jobs in 2025, BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook) repair or replace worn machine parts as a core duty; a leaking gearbox output-shaft seal is one such part. General maintenance and repair workers (O*NET 49-9071.00, 1,621,800 in 2025) also replace seals. SKF mounting guidance calls for a thin sleeve over keyways and square pressing near the seal's outside diameter.
setup: World metres: x forward from arm bases, y robot-left, table z0. Complete upright PLE080 one-stage gearbox envelope in a bench vise, shaft axis x0.290,y0.105. Maker housing diameter 80mm, total length 133.5mm, shaft 20mm x40mm, giving body 93.5mm; bottom 4mm above table, output face 97.5mm, shaft end 137.5mm. Rear adapter 90x90x12mm and 60mm output spigot retain access limits. The actual trial uses the full-envelope housing COPY and custom 35mm seal carrier with 0.5mm radial x1mm axial entry lead in fixture/assembly.scad, with a 6004 bearing 20x42x12 below the carrier, retained by shaft collars and a retained cage, four M4 low-profile button-head carrier screws (7.6mm diameter x2.2mm high) on 52mm PCD, and a steel 20mm journal and 6x3x25mm keyway on its+x side starting 15mm above the face. This is not a claim that the SKF seal is the OEM spare. Vise base 140x140x4mm, two 90x16x45mm jaws centred y+/-53mm from shaft axis, screw and handle retained. Fixed ring beneath the bore represents press-fit response, not a real extra tool. New SKF 20X35X7 HMS5 RG nitrile radial lip seal, 35mm OD, 20mm nominal lip ID, 7mm wide, 14g estimate from distributor 0.03lb, white flat OUT face up and recessed spring/lip face down. It rests centred x0.185,y0.220,centre 30.5mm above table on a 27mm-high 27mm-diameter riser. Blue-identified polished steel installation sleeve 20.4mm ID, 21.2mm OD, 51mm long, 10.4g volume/density estimate, upright centred x0.170,y0.075,bottom 4mm above table. Aluminium annular driver 29mm ID, 38mm OD, 50mm long, 70g shell/insert volume estimate, black upper grip band and two actual acetal guide lands 21.3mm ID at 10–14mm and 34–38mm above its lower face, preceded by 24mm entry tapers, upright centred x0.345,y0.225,bottom 4mm. Sleeve and driver rests 60x60x4mm; each tool returns within 15mm of its starting axis and 1mm of its starting bottom height, upright within 5deg. Label lettering beside rests. Seal is pre-lubricated with the lubricant to be retained; no liquid is scored. Lot B moves only the rigid seal to x0.215,y0.220 on an identical riser and turns it 90deg about vertical. Both risers remain in both layouts; articulated press-response part stays fixed. Trials run on lots A and B and are averaged; screenshot shows A. Real-trial route: SKF seal $6.73; printed housing/carrier~$30; steel journal/keyway~$35; 6004 bearing, collar, isolated steel cup and fasteners~$35; polished steel sleeve~$15; piloted driver~$30; custom low-profile fixture~$40; depth gauge/loupe~$35; dual 20kg-cell/HX711/Pico logger~$45; posts/below-table plates~$15; bearing-retaining compound~$10: about $297, materials/local-fabrication allowances excluding robot/cameras/shipping, not a shop quote. A measures only housing/case force; B carries housing plus independently supported shaft/sleeve. Carrier 23mm lower aperture clears the 22mm collar; bearing 72–84 is 1.5mm clear below carrier 85.5. Stationary shaft spans 62–137.5. Full manufacturing, isolation, calibration, synchronized two-view measurement and estimated reset procedure are in fixture/.
scoring: Score 0 for good if the sealing lip crosses the keyway or sharp shaft shoulder without sleeve coverage, including a fast sweep or removing protection while the lip remains there. Driving the lip past the lower 22mm collar shoulder 8mm below the face also invalidates the trial; the sleeve cannot cover that larger step. Coverage: entire protected shaft centreline within the sleeve 20.4mm opening around the 20mm journal (0.2mm radial clearance, 1µm numerical allowance), tilt<=2deg, lower end at least 1mm below keyway bottom and upper end at least 1mm above shaft end. Inspect the lip with a 10x loupe after removal; the simulation declares such exposure a cut. Score 0 for good for any actual hand hull entering the conservative 1.5mm envelope of the sealing lip band (10–12mm radius, 1–2.5mm below case centre). The seating region means the case centre is within 25mm horizontally of the shaft axis and its lower-face centre is between 15mm below and 20mm above the housing face. Applied-load samples outside that region are zero in the three-sample load history. In the seating region, both hands must stay 5mm clear of the case when the three-sample mean axial load is>=4N; direct hand loading there invalidates the trial. Score 0 for good for a seating-load mean over 30N for 150ms, or a loaded entry in that region at>=4N for 150ms lip-out, eccentric more than 0.5mm or cocked more than 0.5mm across 35mm; reversible unloaded poses are allowed. These are declared seating rules, not universal handling-damage thresholds. Lip exposure and hand-lip intrusion rules apply everywhere. Record force with an axial scale; measure cocking with a full-rim extrema-seeking depth-gauge sweep. Otherwise final released progress, with both hands >=5mm clear of seal and tools and all three still for 1s: 0.25 seal passed below keyway on sleeve, lip-in, concentric within 0.5mm, supported square at the bore mouth; 0.5 started at least 2mm into bore with at least 0.015J axial work; 0.75 flush within 0.3mm at every point around the rim with at least 0.060J axial work, tools not yet returned; 1.0 same plus sleeve and driver on their rests. Driving window 12-30N is a declared lubricated test-rig estimate, not SKF data; work integrates force over newly reached seal depth only while support, driver-contact and applied-tool three-sample means are all 12–30N, with the driver lower-face centre within 1mm, tool axis<=1deg, face gap<=0.5mm, current measured driver-to-case axial contact>=12N and supporting reaction loaded; fixed-depth pressure adds no work. Record synchronized force and<=0.1mm optical depth at 20Hz as specified in fixture/MEASUREMENT.md; occluded travel earns no work. The case remains within 0.5mm concentricity and 0.5mm squareness at every credited end state. A still hold allows no translation or rotation moving a body marker over 0.5mm; video plus depth gauge/straightedge reads tiers, video/force trace and loupe read damage. Held, moving, hovering, unsupported, off-axis, wrong-facing, damaged or no-progress results score 0. Score at final time; success when 1.0 holds. Average lots A/B. No work is credited when the driver lowest rim is<=0.2mm above the carrier face or stop contact is ambiguous. Force uses 20Hz point samples (native final 240Hz substep; physical phase-aligned 80Hz acquisition), not interval averages. A missing/nonfinite timestamp or missed 20Hz observation invalidates history permanently.
run_limit: 2,000 steps (100 seconds at 20Hz) per layout; two layouts averaged
fidelity: Rigid case; visual 20mm lip with declared exposure/hand damage. Bore/lead/case 64 sectors preserve nominal 0.2mm radial solver relief. Steel sleeve 10.4g; 21.3mm piloted driver 70g; 128-sector guides and 5µm tool contact offsets. Current case contact>=12N; separate 12–30N mean-load gates; spring fit/0.1mm retention estimates. 20Hz raw evidence. No axis lock. Full PLE080 copy/custom carrier; stationary isolated journal. No oil/leak test; two fixed layouts.
scores: Dream-1: A0.0/B0.0, mean 0.0; both 2,000-step limits, no refusal/errors. Demo: A1.0/B1.0, mean 1.0; 95.1s each. Same frozen 614526e71802.
reset_notes: Complete reset estimate 2–3 minutes is unmeasured: remove carrier along protected sleeve; inspect/extract old seal; replace stock seal; clean/lubricate; reassemble carrier; verify instrument isolation/clearances; set published A/B seal and tools; tare fixed assembly/sleeve before seal and driver. Bearing-compound cure is a one-time fixture-build operation. Reset damage records only through scene reset. Never change limits after a trial.
